name: Cinazepam
summary: Nalobrazepam (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known as cinazepam or BD-798 and sold under the brand name Levana in Ukraine, is an atypical benzodiazepine derivative.

pharmacology.text: Cinazepam has an order of magnitude lower affinity for the benzodiazepine receptor of the GABAA complex relative to other well-known hypnotic benzodiazepines such as nitrazepam and phenazepam.

uses.text: Nalobrazepam (INN), also known as cinazepam or BD-798 and sold under the brand name Levana in Ukraine, is an atypical benzodiazepine derivative.

summaryZh: 西那西泮（英語：Cinazepam，代號：BD-798），商品名為Levana，是一種非典型的苯二氮䓬類衍生物。它產生顯著的催眠、鎮靜和抗焦慮作用，同時具有最小的肌肉鬆弛副作用。
summaryZhHans: 西那西泮（英语：Cinazepam，代号：BD-798），商品名为Levana，是一种非典型的苯二氮䓬类衍生物。它产生显着的催眠、镇静和抗焦虑作用，同时具有最小的肌肉松弛副作用。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness, poor coordination and memory problems. As it becomes a phenazepam-like drug in the body, it can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause severe withdrawal, including seizures. In overdose it can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、頭暈、協調變差與記憶問題。由於它在體內會轉化成類似芬納西泮的物質，可能導致依賴，規律使用後突然停藥可能引發包括癲癇發作在內的嚴重戒斷反應。過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、头晕、协调制差与记忆问题。由于它在体内会转化成类似芬纳西泮的物质，可能导致依赖，规律使用后突然停药可能引发包括癫痫发作在内的严重戒断反应。过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: Cinazepam was developed in Ukraine. The body turns it into 3-hydroxyphenazepam, an active breakdown product of the better-known phenazepam.
fact.zh: 西那西泮在烏克蘭研發。身體會把它轉化成 3-羥基芬納西泮，也就是較知名的芬納西泮的活性代謝物。
fact.zhHans: 西那西泮在乌克兰研发。身体会把它转化成 3-羟基芬纳西泮，也就是较知名的芬纳西泮的活性代谢物。
